title: Good for a laugh
text: Good for a laugh. I assume this is meant as a gag gift, right?  Cumbersome, awkward, and just try getting out of it to answer the door!  Well, I'll pass it along to some unsuspecting soul and sit back to watch the fun.  OMG, I can just picture some poor old grandma or grandpa trying to figure it out.  Wicked, wicked, but then it takes all kinds of people to appreciate a gift like this.
